anim-farmer-0: Use case: stylized-concept. Production ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET for cozy Vietnamese farming game. Character: young Vietnamese male farmer tan skin black hair green shirt brown trousers conical non la. Match the character identity from row 1 of the reference image; reference is STYLE AND IDENTITY ONLY, not edit target. Exactly 5 columns by 6 rows = 30 distinct full-body poses on a square transparent PNG. Equal cells, whole character each inside central 60%, at least 40px genuinely transparent gutters. NO touching, no labels, no text, grid, floor, cast shadows, or scenery. Warm hand-painted 3D cartoon, sharp edges. Same anatomy, face, outfit, hat, camera distance, head size and foot baseline in EVERY cell. Row-major animation: cells 1-8 one complete 8-phase walk cycle facing southwest (left and toward camera); cells 9-16 one complete 8-phase walk cycle facing northwest (left and AWAY from camera, back visible); cells 17-20 gentle idle breathing and blinking four phases, front-left; cells 21-24 four phases hoeing soil with a small hoe, front-left; cells 25-30 six phases fishing with rod in hand, front-left, cast then hold then pull. Walk phases in order: left heel contact, left down, left passing, left up, right heel contact, right down, right passing, right up. Genuinely alternating feet and counter-swing arms, no duplicate poses. Do not translate the character across a cell. Keep every silhouette fully separate with wide transparent gaps. Only 30 figures, no accessories outside their figure.

anim-animals-0: Use case: stylized-concept. Production animated animal sprite atlas for Vietnamese cozy farming game. Match species appearances in the reference nature atlas, which is a STYLE AND IDENTITY reference only. Square PNG, REAL TRANSPARENT background. Exactly 6 columns by 6 rows = 36 isolated sprites. Equal cells, each complete animal centered within middle 60%, minimum 40px fully transparent gutters ALL sides. No labels, grid, ground, shadows, text or scenery. Premium warm hand-painted 3D cartoon, crisp edges. ROWS1-2: brown hen with red comb, small wings and two visible legs. ROWS3-4: black and white dairy cow, four legs, small horns, pink udder. ROWS5-6: white duck orange bill and webbed orange feet. For EACH animal its first EIGHT cells are eight sequential phases of a natural walk (or wing flap flight for bee/butterfly); its last FOUR cells are gentle idle breathing/blinking (or hover/perch). All face LEFT in 3/4 view. For quadrupeds coordinate a real alternating four-leg gait, flex joints, lift hooves/paws, swing tail. For birds articulate alternating steps and head counter-motion. Same identity, size, camera, body proportions and foot baseline in every frame; no growing, shrinking, sliding across cell or duplicate poses. EACH species has exactly 12 frames, read row-major over its two complete rows. No animal parts may touch any other sprite. All legs, tails, ears, wings completely visible.

One isolated connected effect sprite per cell centered in middle 55%, very WIDE fully transparent gutters. No diffuse glow crossing cell boundaries.
